scope: Only the separate UI/contract label at exactly zero damping. Numeric values, parameters and regime comparisons at positive damping remain unchanged. Mathematically zero damping belongs to the oscillatory roots case, but the product contract labels it separately.
mapping: zeta == 0: undamped; 0 < zeta < 1: underdamped; zeta == 1: critical; zeta > 1: overdamped
